description: Read an official legal document, or list them. Name an instrument and it returns the text in force with its publication status and available information for checking the copy; any unpublished working text is clearly labelled. Name none and it lists the documents, their versions and whether each is published, as read_instruments does. Use it when: I want the full text of the Constitution, an Act, a rule or a procedure document as it stands, or to see which ones there are. Credential: none. Cost: Free. Source: Constitution 10.4.

instrument.description: An instrument ID, for example JUDICATURE_ACT or PD1; omit it to list them all

name: read_instrument
